Why Appstle Subscriptions is the best Shopify app

Explore and compare Appstle Subscriptions app with other Shopify and Shopify Plus apps for setting up eCommerce subscriptions on your online or omnichannel store.

Book a demo

About Appstle Subscriptions

Appstle Subscriptions is a comprehensive recurring order app for Shopify and Shopify Plus stores and brands.

It provides a comprehensive suite of advanced features, including multiple types of subscription models, loyalty-enhancing features, 1-click checkout, churn control, easy migration, and powerful customization, among others.

Considered the best subscriptions app with over 3,000+ 5 star reviews (as of December 2024), it is trusted by some of the largest eCommerce brands globally.

Appstle Subscriptions App Features:

  • Security and stability
  • Support and customizations for different types of subscription models
  • Widget customizations and comprehensive merchant control of subscriptions settings
  • Lost sales/failed payments retrieval and subscriber churn control
  • Subscriptions options at variants and SKU level
  • Flexible subscriptions billing and recurring payment options
  • Integrated checkout with Shopify checkout
  • Bulk automations
  • Gift subscriptions and free trial for subscribers
  • Detailed and granular analytics and reporting
  • Easy and complimentary integration with third-party Shopify apps
  • 24/7/365 customer support
  • Dedicated infrastructure and storage for Enterprise merchants
  • Dedicated Relationship Managers for Shopify Plus and Enterprise plan merchants

Great product and great team! I migrated our subscription offerings from another subscription service, the Appstle team has been incredibly helpful in this migration and their subscription product is the best one I've worked with.

I use this app for my first ever subscription service and I am blown away by how easy it is to use and how amazing their customer service is!
